confirm1 = math_ids[512:768]
confirm2 = math_ids[768:1024]
splits = {'diag': diag, 'select': select, 'confirm1': confirm1, 'confirm2': confirm2, 'gsm_spare': gsm_ids}
json.dump(splits, open('/work/splits.json','w'), indent=1)
print({k: len(v) for k,v in splits.items()})
